title: works like it should
text: works like it should. Bought this because my Mom wanted to try make Musubi with SPAM.  It's an accquired taste (I don't like it) but Mom LOVES it.  The press is easy to use and clean.  If you plan to make for more than one or two people, you might want to buy a couple of presses to keep up.  :)
